history.content: Can I afford a $900 trip to Austin next weekend?

Honest answer: I can't see your accounts or budget, so I can't give you a real yes or no. What I can tell you is the trip probably costs more than $900 once you count food, Ubers, and whatever you do there, call it $1,100, 1,300 all in.

Quick gut check: do you have that amount sitting in checking after rent and bills are covered for the month? If yes, and you're not dipping into savings, it's a yes from me.

If you tell me roughly what you've got coming in and going out this month, I'll do the math with you.
